questions.question: What is the estimated mean total cost in millions of 2023 dollars for nontyphoidal Salmonella infections?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_foodborne_illness_cost_by_pathogen.xlsx', sheet_name='MeanTotalAndPerCaseCosts', header=None)
data = df.iloc[2:33]
row = data[data[1].str.contains('Salmonella spp., nontyphoidal', na=False)]
result = float(row[3].values[0])

questions.question: Does Campylobacter spp. cause more average annual cases than non-typhoidal Salmonella?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('ers_foodborne_illness_cost_by_pathogen.xlsx', sheet_name='MeanTotalAndPerCaseCosts', header=None)
data = df.iloc[2:33]
camp = float(data[data[1].str.contains('Campylobacter spp.', na=False)][2].values[0])
salm = float(data[data[1].str.contains('Salmonella spp., nontyphoidal', na=False)][2].values[0])
result = 'yes' if camp > salm else 'no'
